name: Open Theism

phase_0.boundary_condition: the temporal horizon of divine-human relationality

VINIT.justification: the state of divine solitude before the decision to create free agents

TANCH.justification: the final state where all temporal contingencies are resolved into the divine life

AFWD.justification: the forward movement of time and the realization of specific historical events

AREV.justification: the godhead adjusting intentions or expressions in response to creaturely actions

CLINK.justification: the sequential chaining of divine promises and human responses over time

IMSCRIB.justification: the immutable essence of love that remains self-identical despite changing knowledge of the future

FSPLIT.justification: the branching of a single historical moment into multiple mutually exclusive possible futures

FFUSE.justification: the divine capacity to incorporate any creaturely choice back into the overarching sovereign purpose

EVALT.justification: the branch where creaturely freedom coincides with the divine will

EVALF.justification: the branch where creaturely freedom opposes the divine will

ENGAGR.justification: the state where god simultaneously holds the ideal will and the reality of rebellion without immediate resolution

IFIX.justification: the irreversible fixation of a choice once it has been made in time

phase_3.void_description: the silence of the godhead before the first creative word
phase_3.true_description: the realization of a possibility that honors the covenantal bond
phase_3.false_description: the realization of a possibility that ruptures the covenantal bond
phase_3.both_description: the divine experience of an open future containing both potential grief and potential joy

steps.domain_action: the godhead exists in self-sufficient plenitude before the inception of time
the divine nature identifies itself as essentially relational and loving
the act of creation initiates a temporal flow external to the divine essence
the creator grants libertarian freedom to agents creating a fork in historical possibility
the agent chooses an action that aligns with the divine invitation
the chosen action enters the permanent record of the past as an unchangeable fact
god incorporates the righteous act into the unfolding plan for the cosmos
the system transitions to the next moment of relational interaction
a second fork emerges where the agent faces a new moral or existential decision
the agent chooses an action that deviates from the divine desire
the deviation is fixed in time as a historical reality that god now knows as fact
god responds to the deviation by altering the immediate providential path to seek redemption
the divine mind holds the tension between the fixed past and the open future
god integrates the failure into a larger narrative of grace ensuring the ultimate purpose remains intact
the ongoing dialogue between divine sovereignty and human freedom continues
the temporal sequence concludes in the final reconciliation of all free acts within the divine life

phase_5.compiler_frontend: the divine logos translating eternal purposes into temporal invitations
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: prayer and revelation serving as the communication channels between the creator and the created
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the divine omniscience of the past and present which grows as time unfolds
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the kairos moments that determine the timing of significant redemptive interventions
phase_5.alfs_store: the sacred scriptures and the moral law providing the baseline for evaluating creaturely acts

phase_6.cycle_cost: the divine risk of genuine suffering and the possibility of creaturely rejection
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: a state of pure potentiality within the divine plan
phase_6.post_cycle_state: a state of actualized history where possibilities have become fixed facts
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the loss of potentiality is exactly balanced by the gain of actualized relational history
